Florida International ranks 24th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 32.5%. Kennesaw State ranks 132nd in the FBS with 78.2 penalty yards per game. Kennesaw State ranks last in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 94.4% of trips. Florida International's red zone offense ranks 105th, scoring in 80.6% of red zone trips. Kennesaw State ranks 132nd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:09, compared to Florida International's 11th-ranked average of 32:38. Team leaders Kennesaw State Passing: Rickie Collins, 1,672 yards, 7 TDs, 7 INTs, 69.9 completion percentage Rushing: Alan Woods III, 549 yards on 117 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Brayden Munroe, 460 yards on 31 catches, 0 TDs Florida International Passing: J.J. Kohl, 2,332 yards, 12 TDs, 12 INTs, 61.6 completion percentage Rushing: Devonte Lyons, 707 yards on 137 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Maguire Anderson, 723 yards on 51 catches, 4 TDs Last game Kennesaw State defeated Sam Houston 26-7 on Nov. 14. Landon Varnes led Kennesaw State with 181 yards on 22-of-35 passing (62.9%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Woods carried the ball 17 times for 101 yards, adding four receptions for 38 yards and one touchdown. Davis Bryson had six receptions for 56 yards. Florida International lost 24-16 to Delaware on Nov. 14. Kohl led Florida International with 313 yards on 26-of-37 passing (70.3%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. He also carried the ball two times for 22 yards. Lyons had 56 rushing yards on 19 carries and one touchdown, adding four receptions for 40 yards. Anderson recorded 122 yards on nine catches. Next game Kennesaw State plays at Western Kentucky on Nov. 28. Florida International hosts Sam Houston on Nov. 28.
